metadata.title: A counterexample to the strong version of the union of uniform closed balls conjecture in dimensions three and higher
metadata.abstract: Fifteen years after its formulation and following its recent proof in the plane, we show that the strong version of the union of uniform closed balls conjecture fails in every dimension $n\geq 3$. For every $n\geq 3$, $r>0$, and $\varepsilon>0$, we construct a compact set $S\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfying the interior $r$-sphere condition and containing a point that belongs to no closed ball of radius $(1/2+\varepsilon)r$ contained in $S$. Consequently, the known universal radius $r/2$ is optimal in every dimension $n\geq 3$, even for compact sets, whereas the optimal radius in the plane is $r/\sqrt{3}$. The construction uses simplices with coincident circumcenter and incenter and yields an exact formula for the largest radius of a contained ball covering the center; the regular simplex recovers the original example motivating the conjecture.

analysis.progressType: 高维滚动球半径的尖锐反例
analysis.workSummary: 对每个n≥3、r>0、ε>0，作者构造满足内部r球条件的紧集S⊂Rⁿ，其中有一点不属于任何完全含于S的半径(1/2+ε)r闭球。由此强形式等半径闭球并集猜想在所有n≥3失败，且已知普适半径r/2最优。平面最优半径为r/√3。

外心和内心重合的单纯形
覆盖中心的最大内含球半径公式
analysis.breakthrough: 将高维反例推进到任意接近普适半径r/2的尖锐范围，并用单纯形的精确公式解释原有正则单纯形例子。
analysis.limitations: 反例是紧集，未在摘要中要求其边界光滑或集合凸。结论区分平面与所有n≥3维。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
